summary.text: Henry L. Johns is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Courtney Sappington (R).
Ballotpedia lists him as a retired U.S. Army Reserve veteran who served from 1973 to 1983.

paragraphs.text: Johns was born in Torrance, California, graduated from Brandon High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Friends University in 2006, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he served in the Army as a clinical laboratory specialist, worked as a licensed respiratory therapist and then in sleep medicine, spent the last 20 years of his career as a manager in private practice and at the Veterans Administration, and later became a substitute teacher in the Baldwin and Lawrence school districts.
He said in the survey that he has lived in Douglas County since 1975.

In that survey, Johns named bodily autonomy and healthcare access, a tax plan with property tax relief including restored Local Ad Valorem Tax Reduction funding, and full funding of public schools as key messages.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
